name: Shihi Bali
description: is a three-story nightlife venue in Seminyak that combines an upscale Japanese-inspired restaurant with multi-level nightclubs. The ground floor features the Izakaya Lounge for dining and cocktails, while the second floor is a high-energy club playing EDM and the top floor is an R&B and Hip Hop room. The venue is known for its top DJs, elaborate light shows, and premium sound system.
openingHours: Daily: 17:00 – 04:00 (kitchen/lounge opens 17:00, club goes late until ~04:00)
priceRange: Free entry / no cover (for lounge/restaurant early). Night-club entry for men often ~IDR 200.000–250.000 (redeemable for drinks); drinks IDR 100.000–150.000; typical dinner + drink IDR 300.000–400.000 per person
